name: huawei-wiki
description: Read and write Huawei CloudDevOps Wiki documents via the remote `wiki-mcp` MCP server (mcpgateway.his.huawei.com). Exposes fetch/create/overwrite wiki content, comments, document search/listing, and the full countersign (会签) workflow. No authentication required — the server is an unauthenticated remote MCP endpoint on the intranet. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).

network.note: The endpoint is on the Huawei intranet. It must bypass the corporate HTTP proxy (proxyuk.huawei.com:8080) or the connection fails. The wrapper script sets NO_PROXY automatically via a no-proxy opener; when loading the MCP config into an agent, ensure NO_PROXY includes mcpgateway.his.huawei.com.

auth_detail: Most tools (fetch/search/list content) need no auth. User-scoped tools (list_my_*) and write tools require X-Auth-Token. Set WIKI_X_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment (wrapper) or add X-Auth-Token to headers (config).
